description:
Release v9.6.8 of the ℤ/9 Vortex Framework deposit. 924 theorems across 41 Lean 4 files, each closed by exhaustion over a stated finite domain, sorry-free and axiom-free; an append-only ledger of 2880 entries, 924 standing, whose receipt chain is recomputed on every build. README.md and CHANGELOG.md travel with this version; the changelog is derived from the annotated tags themselves, so a row cannot claim a content-address its tag does not carry.

Citing works, and the role of each. Measured 2026-09-20 from DataCite and OpenAlex. 7 work(s) cite these DOIs: 7 written by the author, 0 by a third party, 0 whose identifier did not resolve. A self-citation is provenance and is counted separately, because counting it as uptake is the flattering direction.

These results were registered before the source repository existed; if the same constructions appear elsewhere, which came first, and is this record cited there? No third-party citation has resolved to date, and uncited use has NOT been searched for — that needs content matching, not citation tracking, and it has not been run. Absence in a citation graph is not evidence of anyone’s conduct. This deposit’s receipts are signed by agent: eight carry agent: "captain"; statements bounding the claim carried claude-opus and Claude. By what means did those models compute the claims they made here, and on whose authority were they written in the author’s name?
